DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Promyelocytic Leukemia (APL).

The combination of severe pancytopenia (low hemoglobin and platelets) with an extremely high WBC count and the presence of Auer rods (needle-shaped inclusions) on the smear is pathognomonic for this condition, which requires immediate treatment with All-trans retinoic acid (ATRA) to prevent fatal bleeding.
